quote: Elwyn Berlekamp, John Horton Conway and Richard Guy have conjectured that the sequence does become periodic eventually
posed_by: Elwyn Berlekamp, John Horton Conway, Richard Guy
note: The periodicity conjecture for Grundy's game was posed by Berlekamp, Conway, and Guy in their foundational work 'Winning Ways for Your Mathematical Plays' (Academic Press, 1982), Volume 1, Chapter 4. The game itself was originally defined by P. Grundy in 1939, but the specific question of whether the nim-sequence is eventually periodic originated with the 1982 publication.
